Ilya “m0NESY” Osipov is a Russian professional Counter-Strike 2 player. He is currently playing for Falcons Esports as an AWPer. Born on May 1, 2005, he is considered one of the game’s greatest talents. He was invited to play in FPL (FACEIT’s highest PUG league, where professionals play pickup games) at just 14 years old.
